title: Concept: OS command execution via shell/sh(payload) (clojure) — review required
description: In clojure, shell/sh(payload) executes external commands. Shell metacharacters in untrusted input break out of the intended command. The remedy is sh with an args vector.
applicability: clojure codebases launching processes; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Command execution on untrusted input; HIGH severity.
